counterevidence_searched: Checked CSoundManager::Start and CSoundManager::LoadSample in k2_x64.dll (+0x9E7260..+0x9E72A0) to ensure pre-initialization calls (this+0x20 == 0) or runtime ReloadRes/SetMod archive swaps cannot permanently poison valid samples in the negative cache.

obligations.description: Verify exact 15-byte RIP-free prologue (48 8B C4 48 89 58 10 44 89 40 18 48 89 48 08) at CSoundManager::LoadSample (k2_x64.dll + 0x9E7260) via PatchController::InstallManagedInlineHook64 and normalize wide sample paths in a fixed-capacity SRWLOCK-guarded open-addressed table with exact wcscmp + flags matching and zero heap allocations inside __try frames.

Only record nullptr returns from CSoundManager::LoadSample in the negative cache when CSoundManager::m_bInitialized (*((const uint8_t*)pThis + 0x20) != 0) is true so pre-FMOD-init calls never poison valid sound paths.
Clear the CSoundManager::LoadSample negative sample cache whenever ReloadRes, SoundRestart, SetMod, ReloadInterfaces, or ResourceCmd is dispatched through Hooked_CConsole_Execute.
